title: Small Boat Sailing Safety Procedures
description: Panels illustrate man overboard rescue drills, shallow water hazards, lifejacket usage, and small boat navigation.
caption: Panels illustrate man overboard rescue drills, shallow water hazards, lifejacket usage, and small boat navigation.

title: Emergency Weather and Capsizing Protocols
description: Panels show sailors righting a capsized boat, swimming to safety, and monitoring stormy squall clouds over open water.
caption: Panels show sailors righting a capsized boat, swimming to safety, and monitoring stormy squall clouds over open water.

title: Swimming and Water Safety Assessment
description: A Scout monitors fellow troop members completing open water swimming tests beside a wooden lake dock.
caption: A Scout monitors fellow troop members completing open water swimming tests beside a wooden lake dock.

title: Water Safety and Swimming Proficiency
description: Four panels depict water safety checks, swimming test supervision, buddy pair monitoring, and life jacket fittings.
caption: Four panels depict water safety checks, swimming test supervision, buddy pair monitoring, and life jacket fittings.

title: Inspecting Rigged Sailboat at Dock
description: A sailing instructor and two Scouts inspect the mast, boom, and hull of a docked sailboat.
caption: A sailing instructor and two Scouts inspect the mast, boom, and hull of a docked sailboat.

title: Sailboat Parts and Points Sail
description: Panels detail sailboat rigging components alongside compass diagrams displaying relative wind angles and points of sail.
caption: Panels detail sailboat rigging components alongside compass diagrams displaying relative wind angles and points of sail.

title: Observing Wind Direction on Water
description: An instructor points toward water ripples to teach two Scouts how to read wind direction and gusts.
caption: An instructor points toward water ripples to teach two Scouts how to read wind direction and gusts.

title: Essential Small Boat Equipment Inspection
description: Panels show personal flotation devices, bailing buckets, auxiliary paddles, and rigging wind indicators.
caption: Panels show personal flotation devices, bailing buckets, auxiliary paddles, and rigging wind indicators.

title: Measuring Wind Speed on Shore
description: Scouts hold a handheld wind meter and signal flags along the sandy beach to assess lake sailing conditions.
caption: Scouts hold a handheld wind meter and signal flags along the sandy beach to assess lake sailing conditions.

title: Maritime Knots and Rigging Hitches
description: Four panels show the tying of figure-eight stoppers, square knots, bowlines, and secure deck cleat hitches.
caption: Four panels show the tying of figure-eight stoppers, square knots, bowlines, and secure deck cleat hitches.

title: Sailing Sloop Across Calm Lake
description: Two Scouts steer a small sloop under full mainsail across a tranquil lake bordered by wooded hillsides.
caption: Two Scouts steer a small sloop under full mainsail across a tranquil lake bordered by wooded hillsides.

title: Hoisting and Trimming Boat Sails
description: Illustrated segments depict stepping the mast, attaching halyards, hoisting the mainsail, and trimming sails while underway.
caption: Illustrated segments depict stepping the mast, attaching halyards, hoisting the mainsail, and trimming sails while underway.

title: Practicing Marine Knots by Lake
description: A counselor guides a Scout through tying secure nautical knots with braided marine rope on the shoreline.
caption: A counselor guides a Scout through tying secure nautical knots with braided marine rope on the shoreline.

title: Helmsman Commands and Tacking Maneuvers
description: Panels explain tacking protocols, jibing turns, and standardized helmsman voice commands used during small boat maneuvers.
caption: Panels explain tacking protocols, jibing turns, and standardized helmsman voice commands used during small boat maneuvers.

title: Rigging Small Sailboat on Shore
description: Scouts and their counselor prepare a small sailboat hull and step the mast on a lakeside grassy lawn.

title: Capsize Recovery and Hull Bailing
description: Illustrated sequences show sailors righting a turtled dinghy, climbing over the gunwale, and bailing flooded cockpit water.
caption: Illustrated sequences show sailors righting a turtled dinghy, climbing over the gunwale, and bailing flooded cockpit water.

title: Reviewing Nautical Lake Navigation Chart
